annotations.title: Pre-buy check for a token (risk signals before you buy)

description: One fast call before buying a token (Solana mint, mainly pump.fun): verdict clear / caution / avoid / unknown, risk_score 0-100 and reasons[] (code + one line). Combines brand imitation and older, bigger tokens with the same ticker; creator wallet reputation (score, band, confidence); bundled launch and early-holder concentration; age, trades in 24 h, liquidity and graduation. Mints not in our data return verdict unknown, never an estimate. Informational only, not financial advice, no guarantee. Free/keyless: verdict, score and reason codes; full report with any API key, or x402 pay-per-call at $0.01 USDC: GET /v1/x402/prebuy/{mint}.

mint.description: Token mint address (Solana base58; EVM 0x... also accepted for brand checks).
